reason: I always get three quotes from local firms I can actually go and see, and pick the middle one. A company in Kuwait with no past clients asking for half up front by PayPal isn't going on my shortlist, however cheap it looks.
objection: They're in Kuwait, not Manchester, with nothing to show. If they disappear with my 50% deposit I've no one to chase and no local reputation they'd be protecting.
would_change_my_mind: A few real UK clients I could ring for a reference, plus a much smaller deposit, or paying only once I've seen and approved the design.
